notes.title: The Last Patch for Neon Parkour
notes.content:
We changed some logos, texts and fonts in the game. Neon Parkour is now a complete game. So, we are working on our future project(s). We'll announce the details when we're ready.

  Thank you for supporting us!

notes.title: Neon Parkour - 1st Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Today is the [b]1st anniversary[/b] of Neon Parkour and we released v1.5 update for today.

  With this update;
  [b]+[/b] Added slowmotion
  [b]+[/b] Bugs fixed

  Thank you for your supports!

  [i][b]Aquila Team[/b][/i]

notes.title: Neon Parkour Update v0.7.5 Released!
notes.content:
[b]Neon Parkour v0.7.5 is now available. With that update;[/b]
-Bugs fixed.
-New levels added. Neon Parkour has 40 levels now!

We are so close to full version.

[i]Thank you for your support,[/i]
[b]Aquila Team[/b]

notes.title: Neon Parkour Patch v0.3
notes.content:
With that patch;
-Timer bugs fixed.
-Death Counter bugs fixed.
-Climb bug fixed.

notes.title: Neon Parkour Patch v0.2.7
notes.content:
[b]Neon Parkour Patch v0.2.7 is available now![/b]

+2 new soundtracks added to game.

You can change the music with that patch. To do that, go to "Settings" and click the button next to the music icon.
